text: 周五（10月2日）纽约尾盘，美国10年期基准国债收益率涨2.99个基点，报5.2706%，北京时间20:30发布非农就业报告时跳水、一分钟内跌至5.1528%刷新日低，全天呈现出V形反转，本周累计上涨11.02个基点，9月28日-10月1日持续上涨。 两年期美债收益率涨3.12个基点，报4.8247%，非农就业数据披露后从4.78%附近跳水、两分钟内刷新日低至4.6913%，随后持续上扬、01:28刷新日高至4.8477%，本周累跌2.69个基点。
text_en: Friday (October 2) at the late New York session, the U.S. 10-year benchmark Treasury yield rose 2.99 basis points to 5.2706%, plunging at 20:30 Beijing time when the nonfarm payrolls report was released, falling within one minute to 5.1528% to refresh the daily low, showing a V-shaped reversal throughout the day, and rising 11.02 basis points cumulatively this week, continuing to rise from September 28 to October 1. The two-year U.S. Treasury yield rose 3.12 basis points to 4.8247%, plunging from around 4.78% after the nonfarm payrolls data was disclosed, refreshing the daily low to 4.6913% within two minutes, then continuing to rise and refreshing the daily high to 4.8477% at 01:28, falling 2.69 basis points cumulatively this week.
